steps.content: This time, the bullets are swift and tricky. 000 is about to fire again, and you are barely holding out.
At this moment, a fit of laughter suddenly erupts from outside.
The dozing duck wakes up with a start, and the Assassin Zone is lifted.
You attack 000, but she instantly vanishes like a projection.
Well done. The power is yours.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: ...This isn't her real self, but a projected decoy, so life-like that it could easily be passed off as the real one.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Is this her new ability? Impressive. The power imbued in it felt very real. Even I couldn't tell right away.
If she is so ready to give up this power... Then she must have another target.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or does she think I'm not worth fighting? Are we being slighted?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Heh, I don't think so. Look.
Someone outside pushes the door open, muttering something unintelligible.

steps.speaker: Internet Cafe Boss
steps.content: You've been stuck on this for days. If you can't fix it, just take a break.

steps.speaker: Internet Cafe Boss
steps.content: You've worked yourself to the bone. How can you bring fun to the game in such a sad state? Look at those people actually enjoying their game outside.

steps.speaker: Internet Cafe Boss
steps.content: Playing Pack-Gal on the big screen of the mall... Now that's some proper gaming.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's Mess and EMP. They're making quite a scene outside, and they've attracted a big crowd. It's a real ruckus.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Even after transforming, your companions drew everyone's attention, impacting the world in the process. As long as you hold out long enough, that little duck will wake up and escape 000's assassination. So you've won for sure.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Now, about the next target. I've found some clues already. Maybe this time we can stay ahead of the game.
